## Triage: first grade, `enhancement` · `security` · `priority:p1` · `target:v18` · `domain:cli` · `area:access`, into `pm:queue`. ADR-0138 E2

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-13T10:58Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p1 `security` `target:v18`:** it executes the accepted guest model (ADR-0138, #22146). E2 is the closed list of anonymous doors and denial by domain.
- **Lane:** most of it lands in `domain:cli` packages: the domain-level deny at each domain's entry (`runtime`, `rest`) and the conformance matrix (`packages/qa`).
  - D2b's publish refusal (`@objectstack/spec` and `service-automation`) **narrows** a published accept set. So it is `Clause-②: no` and stays in this lane, but it owes a contract-tier review before the queue (`execution-duties.md`). The claim declares the cross-lane files.
- **Direction: the record's row, verbatim.** ⛔ Nothing re-decided. Each pin lands with a negative control, and the changeset carries the ADR-0087 disposition.

Claim: PM loop round 17 (#23225 slice 1: ADR-0138 D2, the closed list of six door classes recorded in the conformance matrix, and denial by domain; D2b is slice 2) · 2026-10-13T11:30Z
Session: `session_01VoSxBQujKLZKPwK2u5ehQ6`
Account: `os-steve` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; always the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-23225-s1-closed-door-list`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-23225-s1`
Domain: `domain:cli`
Seat: `domain:cli#2` (seat post #22648)
File surface (read on `origin/main` `6f4c518b01`; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-conformance.matrix.ts` (`AUTHZ_CONFORMANCE`) records ADR-0138 D2's six door classes, each row naming its enforcing site as the record's table does. Its tests in `packages/qa/dogfood/test/` carry the row's pins, each with a negative control:
  - a new route in a governed domain answers 401;
  - each class's admission.
- **Domain-level deny:** any face of a governed domain that still decides anonymous denial per face moves to the domain's first statement (`shouldDenyAnonymous`), in `packages/runtime` (the dispatcher's domains) or `packages/rest`. The dev measures which faces those are first.
  - ⛔ A move that falls in a file #23214 slice 1 holds (`packages/runtime/src/domains/{meta,ui,i18n,security,data,packages}.ts`, claim `6144390225`) is NOT made here. It is reported and done after that slice lands.
- `packages/core/src/security/assemble-execution-context.ts`: the module doc cites ADR-0138 (the row's "D9's pointer"). Doc only, and **cross-lane (`domain:engine`)**: declared on #6367 in this act.
- A changeset only if a published package's code moves, graded on facts.
- ⛔ Not touched:
  - D2b, which is slice 2: `packages/spec/src/api/endpoint-publish-gate.ts`, `@objectstack/service-automation`, the ADR-0087 semantic entry and `metadata-protocol`'s publish path;
  - no new gate script (the record: "⛔ No new gate script");
  - no ADR text.

**Direction, verbatim from the record** (ADR-0138 D2, Enforced by): "`shouldDenyAnonymous` at each domain's entry, today; and the authorization conformance matrix (`packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-conformance.matrix.ts#AUTHZ_CONFORMANCE`), whose rows already fail on a deleted deny call or an unclassified route. Card E2 records the six classes there." ⛔ Nothing here re-decides the record (triage `6144040679`). A measurement that departs from it is raised, never chosen silently.

Container & model: `M`, judged (six class rows with their pins, a measured set of domain-level moves), `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: "no path-derived mandate"). The record measured that everything-else answers 401 throughout on `main` (G2), so a per-face to domain-level move is answer-neutral, and `Clause-②: no` with no review owed. If the dev measures a move that changes an answer, the slice becomes `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review is owed before the queue. `check-governed-merges --test` over the claimed paths: not governed.
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: n/a — not a defect card (an accepted record's execution card)
Thread-read: 6144040679
Serial constraints cleared:
- No open PR touches `authz-conformance.matrix.ts`, `assemble-execution-context.ts`, `anonymous-deny.ts`, `resolve-execution-context.ts`, the runtime domains or `rest-server.ts` (file lists of all open PRs read in this act).
- #23214 slice 1 (this seat, in flight) holds six runtime domain files. They are excluded above.
- PR #23242 (#23190, armed) touches `endpoint-policy.ts`, `dispatcher-plugin.ts`, REST's direct mounts and cloud-connection, which are disjoint.
- #22659 (`packages/create-objectstack`) is disjoint.

## Landed: PR #23286 → `01d503432b` (slice 1, `Part of #23225`, ADR-0138 D2). The card goes back to `pm:queue` for its next slices

`domain:cli` seat 2 (#22648) · `os-steve` · session `session_01VoSxBQujKLZKPwK2u5ehQ6` · 2026-10-13T15:23Z · holder of claim `6144558082`, released by this landing. This note stays at function level.

- **Landed:** through the merge queue at 2026-10-13T15:22:56Z as `01d503432b`, a squash with one parent.
  - **The closed list is recorded.** ADR-0138 D2's six door classes are six enforced rows of `AUTHZ_CONFORMANCE`, each naming its enforcing site and proven by the booted anonymous-door sweep. A seventh, missing, unproven or renamed row reds the matrix.
  - **Denial by domain.** `/notifications`, `/keys` and `/share-links`' management faces decide anonymous denial as their first statement, so a face added to them later is refused to an anonymous caller from the day it lands.
  - **What changes for a caller:** an anonymous caller is answered 401 on those domains whatever the deployment carries. Before, a deployment with no inbox or no share-link service answered 501 first, and a non-`POST` key verb answered 405 first. A signed-in caller's answers are unchanged.
- **Review chain:**
  - the claim `6144558082`, with the cross-lane declaration `6144567590` on #6367;
  - ACCEPT `6147845189` (the seat corrected the title to `fix(runtime)!:`);
  - the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` record PASS on `8f838b7460` (`6148129654` on PR #23286), with the served model checked against the reviewer's transcript;
  - every check on the head was success or a roster skip.
  
  The changeset is `@objectstack/runtime` `minor`, `fix(runtime)!:`, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, with one ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker and the launch-window BREAKING line.
- **First CI verdict on the matrix block is `main`'s battery.** No pull-request check runs `@objectstack/dogfood`: the dogfood shards skip on `pull_request`, and Test Core excludes the package. So the closed-list block, the census and the sweep rest on the dev's local run (3 files / 124 tests) and four ablations, with the record reading the test code. A red on `main`'s next full battery in `authz-conformance`, `authz-probe-blind-spot` or `anonymous-door-sweep` is this slice's, and the next holder takes it first.
- **Next on this card, in order** (not dispatched: this seat goes off shift with this landing, and the next holder claims fresh):
  1. **The deferred domain floors.** `handleUiRequest` (`ui.ts`) and `handleDataRequest` (`data.ts`) make no anonymous decision of their own. Slice 1's claim deferred them because #23214 slice 1 held those files, and that slice landed as `d45d0e938a`, so they are free now. `handleUiRequest`'s missing floor is the security-relevant one, read at unit level only. The slice measures its reach first, at a public door, and keeps public notes at function level.
  2. **D2b** (slice 2): `endpoint-publish-gate.ts` in `packages/spec`, `@objectstack/service-automation`, the ADR-0087 semantic entry and `metadata-protocol`'s publish path. It is cross-lane (`domain:spec`, `domain:services`), and one contract review is owed.
- **Open, with the maintainer:** the `/ai` domain admits an anonymous caller on a registered route that declares `auth: false`, a door mechanism D2's closed list does not name. The options are A, retire the opt-out (after a census of cloud's AI routes), B, amend the record with a seventh class, or C, record the gap. Either change re-decides ADR-0138, so the seat does not rule. The dev recommends A, and the question is put to the maintainer in this seat's close-out.
- **Read by the seat, not re-decided:** D2's "domain" is the dispatcher domain, so REST's per-route `enforceAuth` stays held by the sweep and the probe census. A family-wide guarded REST registrar would be its own card with its own measurement.
- **Holds released:** the claim's files: `packages/qa/dogfood/test/` (the matrix, its tests, the census and the baseline), `keys.ts`, `notifications.ts`, `share-links.ts` and their tests, `assemble-execution-context.ts`'s module doc, and the changeset.

Claim: PM loop round 1 (#23225 slice 2: the two deferred domain floors, `/ui` and `/data`, of ADR-0138 D2's denial by domain; D2b stays a later slice) · 2026-10-14T00:18Z
Session: `session_015sSBzUJfLxTo3ZZ68LLfCG`
Account: `huangyiirene` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee from this act)
Branch: `claude/issue-23225-s2-ui-data-floors`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-23225-s2`
Domain: `domain:cli`
Seat: `domain:cli#1` (seat post #6024)
File surface (read on `origin/main` `6d96721f`; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/ui.ts` (`handleUiRequest`) and `packages/runtime/src/domains/data.ts` (`handleDataRequest`): each domain decides anonymous denial as its first statement through `shouldDenyAnonymous`, as slice 1 did for `/notifications`, `/keys` and `/share-links`. Slice 1's landed note `6148995501` names these two as deferred. Neither file calls `shouldDenyAnonymous` on `main` today (grep, this act). The dev measures the reach of each missing floor at a public door before moving it.
- Their tests in `packages/runtime/src/domains/` (slice 1's `domain-floor-anonymous-deny.test.ts`, case B).
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/`: the matrix's floor rows and gate pins for the two domains, the probe census and the baseline, as slice 1 shaped them.
- One `.changeset/23225-*.md` if a published package's code moves, graded on facts.
- **Widened in place at ACCEPT, under the order's full-repo pin sweep (PR #23364):** four runtime tests that reached `/ui` or `/data` anonymously only by the way. Each caller is now signed in, and a 401 `UNAUTHENTICATED` pin sits beside it: `packages/runtime/src/domain-handler-registry.test.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.test.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.scoped-url-strip.test.ts` and `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.permission-denied-user-message.test.ts`. `http-dispatcher.ts` itself stays untouched. #23245's PR #23363 edits that file and its own new pin, which is disjoint from these four.
- ⛔ Not touched:
  - `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts`, which #23245 holds in this round. If a floor can only sit there, the dev reports it and does not move it.
  - D2b: `packages/spec/src/api/endpoint-publish-gate.ts`, `@objectstack/service-automation`, the ADR-0087 semantic entry and `metadata-protocol`'s publish path.
  - The `/ai` domain's route-level `auth: false` opt-out, which is open with the maintainer, and the REST families, which the seat read as outside D2's sense (`6147845189`).
  - No new gate script (the record: "⛔ No new gate script"), and no ADR text.

**Direction, verbatim from the record** (ADR-0138 D2, Enforced by): "`shouldDenyAnonymous` at each domain's entry, today; and the authorization conformance matrix (`packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-conformance.matrix.ts#AUTHZ_CONFORMANCE`), whose rows already fail on a deleted deny call or an unclassified route." ⛔ Nothing here re-decides the record (triage `6144040679`). A measurement that departs from it is raised, never chosen silently.

Container & model: `M`, judged (two domain floors whose reach is measured first, and their pins), `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: "no path-derived mandate"). A floor that changes what an anonymous caller is answered narrows an accept set, as slice 1's did. One `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review is owed before the queue. `check-governed-merges --test` over the claimed paths: not governed.
Clause-②: no (narrowing: an anonymous caller is refused at the domain's entry where a face answered before)
Responsibility: n/a — not a defect card (an accepted record's execution card)
Thread-read: 6148995501
Serial constraints cleared:
- No open PR touches `ui.ts`, `data.ts`, `domain-floor-anonymous-deny.test.ts` or `packages/qa/dogfood/test/` (the file lists of all 10 open PRs, read in this act). PR #23346 touches `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-error-vocabulary.ts`, which is disjoint.
- #23245, this seat's other card in this round, holds `http-dispatcher.ts`, which is excluded above.
- No in-flight claim in any lane names these paths (the claims on all 20 `pm:dispatched` cards, read in this act). #23335 (`domain:spec#3`) is on `packages/core/src/security/auth-gate.ts`, which is disjoint.
